posts.headline: The draft board is finally live and The Thicks has run out of editions to hide behind — a 14-14 career record propping up that ring means #FreeMaxx Champions has one night to prove the throne isn't made of cardboard.
posts.detail: Nine straight editions of questions dodged and now it's pick time — a .500 career mark for a reigning champ is the thinnest resume defending a title in this league's history.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finally has to draft instead of just existing as a punchline, and a dead-last 4-10, 12th-place debut means the untalented tenth is starting this build in a graveyard.
posts.detail: Twelve straight editions of burial talk end tonight with actual picks — a 12th-place finish and .286 winPct is the lowest bar in the league to clear.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World brings a championship into a draft room that thinks it was a total accident — a losing 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish says Big Head has to out-draft the field tonight or confirm the fluke theory forever.
posts.detail: A title with a below-.500 record attached is the most disrespected banner in Busters Anonymous, and tonight's picks are Megamind's only rebuttal.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra has been mocked for thirteen straight editions of silence, but a 20-8 career mark with back-to-back top-2 finishes and zero rings means One Nut Barner is drafting under more expectation than anyone at this table.
posts.detail: A .714 win pct with nothing to show for it is Dallas Cowboys energy — all that talent, no trophy, and tonight's board either fixes that or extends the choke-artist résumé.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is about to make its first real decision of the year, and a rock-bottom 10th-place debut season says Auntie Thomas is contractually obligated to find the hardest possible path to a roster.
posts.detail: A 6-8 record and 10th-place finish in year one gives Pharaoh23 zero margin — bottom-feeders don't get to overthink the draft, they just need bodies that produce.
